title: Assert the escaping Windows probe startup exception after finalization completes
outcome: The release-order probe regression distinguishes the original startup exception from any replacement thrown during finalization.
acceptance: A locale-neutral observation is emitted outside the probe try/finally and asserts the final escaping exception type and native code.
A deterministic finalizer-replacement control demonstrates that the assertion rejects masking, while the existing successful command-release and missing-start controls remain intact.
